reason: One local repair round resolves all five findings. All 65 current direct and indirect consumers were checked and accepted; no published physics or root-mathematics consumers were found. Prepared for final whole-batch review.

findings.reason: Defined the conjugate, tensor, dual and exterior-power scalar actions and bases; made the central-charge generators an explicit basis while preserving the brackets and real form.
Verified that the Lambda maps form a group action. Specified grading parity on actual charge domains and evenness of central charges on their actual domains.
Derived Lorentz invariance of the mass-squared map from determinant preservation and proved the needed countable subadditivity and continuity-from-above arguments locally.
Replaced the unsupported polar-phase assumption with omega=z/|z| for nonzero z (omega=1 at zero) and proved the unit-modulus identities locally.
Defined T_beta on the displayed basis and verified it is the bounded trace-class heat operator for every beta>0, with the stated index.
